```lua
-- Roll karakter untuk spawn di conveyor. Bobot total 100:
-- Common 55, Rare 25, Epic 12, Legendary 6, Mythic 2.
function BrainrotDefs.rollDef()
	local weights = { 27, 28, 12, 13, 6, 6, 3, 3, 1, 1 }
	local total = 0
	for _, w in ipairs(weights) do
		total += w
	end
	local r = math.random(total)
	local acc = 0
	for i, w in ipairs(weights) do
		acc += w
		if r <= acc then
			return BrainrotDefs.List[i]
		end
	end
	return BrainrotDefs.List[1]
end

-- Semua def yang rarity-nya sama dengan `rarity` (untuk hasil fusion).
function BrainrotDefs.ofRarity(rarity)
	local out = {}
	for _, def in ipairs(BrainrotDefs.List) do
		if def.Rarity == rarity then
			table.insert(out, def)
		end
	end
	return out
end

return BrainrotDefs
```

```lua
-- Fusion Bay v3.0 (recorded rebuild) — pusat balancing.
-- Semua angka gameplay hidup di sini. Server menghitung harga, income,
-- dan syarat dari tabel ini; client tidak pernah dipercaya untuk itu.

local Config = {}

Config.GameName = "Fusion Bay"
Config.BuildVersion = "v3.0"
Config.StartCoins = 100
Config.DataStoreName = "FusionBayDataV1"
Config.LeaderboardStoreName = "FusionBay_Earned_V1"
Config.AutosaveSeconds = 180

Config.IncomeTickSeconds = 1
Config.MaxBaseSlots = 6
Config.MaxPlayers = 8
Config.RebirthIncomeBonus = 0.25 -- fallback kalau rebirth melewati tabel

-- Tangga rebirth: level ke-n memakai RebirthLevels[n].
-- Mult adalah pengali income TOTAL setelah rebirth itu, bukan tambahan.
Config.RebirthLevels = {
	{ Cost = 10000, NeedEpic = 5, NeedLegendary = 0, Mult = 2 },
	{ Cost = 50000, NeedEpic = 0, NeedLegendary = 2, Mult = 3 },
	{ Cost = 200000, NeedEpic = 0, NeedLegendary = 5, Mult = 4 },
}

function Config.rebirthMult(rebirths)
	local level = Config.RebirthLevels[rebirths]
	if level then
		return level.Mult
	elseif rebirths > 0 then
		return 1 + Config.RebirthIncomeBonus * rebirths
	end
	return 1
end

function Config.nextRebirth(playerRebirths)
	local level = Config.RebirthLevels[playerRebirths + 1]
	if not level then
		return nil
	end
	return {
		Level = playerRebirths + 1,
		Cost = level.Cost,
		NeedEpic = level.NeedEpic,
		NeedLegendary = level.NeedLegendary,
		Mult = level.Mult,

-- Base lock

-- Wave (tsunami)

Config.WaveSurvivorReward = 50 -- coin untuk yang selamat di base sendiri

-- Shop
Config.ShopItems = {
	{ Id = "boots", Name = "Speed Boots", Price = 1500, Desc = "+4 WalkSpeed permanen" },
	{ Id = "lock", Name = "Base Lock 30s", Price = 500, Desc = "Kunci basemu 30 detik" },
	{ Id = "lucky", Name = "Lucky Ticket", Price = 2000, Desc = "Spawn berikut min. Golden" },
}

-- Skala model 3D per rarity (sebelum pengali visual 2.0x di factory).
Config.RarityScale = {
	Common = 1.0,
	Rare = 1.1,
	Epic = 1.2,
	Legendary = 1.35,
	Mythic = 1.5,
}

-- Warna label rarity.
Config.Rarities = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 255),
	Epic = Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 255),
	Legendary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0),
	Mythic = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 90),
}

-- Mutation: {nama, pengali income, peluang, warna label}
Config.Mutations = {
	{ Name = "Normal", Mult = 1, Chance = 0.85, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) },
	{ Name = "Golden", Mult = 2, Chance = 0.10, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0) },
	{ Name = "Diamond", Mult = 5, Chance = 0.04, Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255) },
	{ Name = "Rainbow", Mult = 10, Chance = 0.01, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 220) },
}

-- FUSION: gabung 2 brainrot rarity sama -> 1 brainrot satu tingkat di
-- atas, mutation dijamin minimal Golden. Mythic + Mythic = Mythic Rainbow.
Config.FusionTiers = { "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "Mythic" }
Config.FusionCooldownSeconds = 10

function Config.nextRarity(rarity)
	for i, r in ipairs(Config.FusionTiers) do
		if r == rarity then
			return Config.FusionTiers[math.min(i + 1, #Config.FusionTiers)]
		end
	end
	return rarity
end

-- Roll mutation hasil fusion: Golden 70%, Diamond 25%, Rainbow 5%.
function Config.rollFusionMutation()
	local r = math.random()
	if r < 0.70 then
		return Config.Mutations[2]
	elseif r < 0.95 then
		return Config.Mutations[3]
	else
		return Config.Mutations[4]
	end
end

function Config.rollMutation(lucky)
	if lucky then
		local r = math.random()
		if r < 0.10 then
			return Config.Mutations[4] -- Rainbow
		elseif r < 0.45 then
			return Config.Mutations[3] -- Diamond
		else
			return Config.Mutations[2] -- Golden
		end
	end
	local r = math.random()
	local acc = 0
	for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do
		acc += m.Chance
		if r <= acc then
			return m
		end
	end
	return Config.Mutations[1]
end

function Config.formatMoney(n)
	n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
	if n >= 1000000 then
		return string.format("$%.1fM", n / 1000000)
	elseif n >= 1000 then
		return string.format("$%.1fK", n / 1000)
	else
		return "$" .. tostring(n)
	end
end

return Config
```

```lua
-- Fusion Bay v3.0 — util kecil yang dipakai server (dan client bila perlu).

local Utils = {}

function Utils.clamp(v, lo, hi)
	if v < lo then
		return lo
	elseif v > hi then
		return hi
	end
	return v
end

-- HumanoidRootPart pemain, nil kalau karakter belum siap.
function Utils.getRoot(player)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

function Utils.getHumanoid(player)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return nil
	end
	return char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

-- Apakah posisi `pos` berada di dalam kotak base (tengah `center`,
-- setengah lebar hx, setengah dalam hz)?
function Utils.insideBase(pos, center, hx, hz)
	return math.abs(pos.X - center.X) < hx and math.abs(pos.Z - center.Z) < hz
end

return Utils
```

```lua
-- Fusion Bay v3.1 (recorded rebuild) — server utama.
-- Bangun map, muat sistem, urus pemain masuk/keluar.
--
-- PENTING (pelajaran playtest v2): script ini ADALAH Script "Server"
-- hasil Rojo (init.server.luau), jadi modul-modul lain adalah ANAK
-- script ini, bukan anak ServerScriptService. require(script.X) benar;
-- require(script.Parent.X) SALAH di sini — itu yang dulu bikin error
-- "MapBuilder is not a valid member of ServerScriptService" dan map kosong.
-- ModuleScript lain (bukan init) memakai script.Parent.X dengan benar,
-- karena Parent mereka adalah Script "Server" ini.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)
local BrainrotDefs = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.BrainrotDefs)
local MapBuilder = require(script.MapBuilder)
local BrainrotFactory = require(script.BrainrotFactory)
local DataSystem = require(script.DataSystem)
local State = require(script.State)
local Spawner = require(script.Spawner)
local EconomySystem = require(script.EconomySystem)
local StealSystem = require(script.StealSystem)
local WaveSystem = require(script.WaveSystem)
local LeaderboardSystem = require(script.LeaderboardSystem)
local Remotes = require(script.Remotes)

-- Remotes dibuat saat modul Remotes di-require (tidak dipakai langsung di sini).
_ = Remotes

MapBuilder.build()

-- v3.3: DIAGNOSTIK MAP — hitung part map yang benar-benar ada di
-- Workspace dan baca tinggi atas Ground dari part-nya langsung, jadi
-- Output sendiri membuktikan map ter-build (bukan cuma "kode lolos").
do
	local ws = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local function countPrefix(prefix)
		local n = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(ws:GetChildren()) do
			if string.sub(child.Name, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
				n += 1
			end
		end
		return n
	end
	local ground = ws:FindFirstChild("Ground")
	local groundTop = ground and (ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2) or -999
	print("[FusionBay] MAP v3.3: Ground top y=" .. groundTop .. ", Conveyor=" .. countPrefix("Conveyor") .. " parts, BasePlatform=" .. countPrefix("BasePlatform") .. " parts")
end

-- v3.3: BRAINROT TES tepat di depan spawn — 10 stud di utara spawn
-- (0, 2.3, 65), di atas tanah plaza (atas y=1.0). Kalau model ini
-- tidak terlihat di frame pertama, masalahnya bukan map-nya, tapi
-- model brainrot-nya sendiri. Bukan milik pemain, tidak bisa dibeli.
do
	local testDef = BrainrotDefs.ById["pisang-kucing"] or BrainrotDefs.List[1]
	local testMutation = Config.Mutations[1] -- Normal
	local testModel = BrainrotFactory.build(testDef, testMutation, BrainrotFactory.bodyCenter(Vector3.new(0, 2.3, 65), testDef), false)
	testModel.Name = "TestBrainrotDepanSpawn"
	testModel.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	BrainrotFactory.setLabel(testModel, testDef, testMutation, nil, false)
	print("[FusionBay] TEST brainrot di depan spawn: " .. testDef.Name .. " di (0, 2.3, 65)")
end

-- Bangun kembali model brainrot milik pemain dari data simpanan
-- (setelah load / rejoin). Model memakai bodyCenter() supaya menapak.
local function spawnOwnedBrainrots(player, data)
	local base = State.baseForPlayer(player)
	if not base then
		return
	end
	for _, owned in ipairs(data.Owned) do
		local def = BrainrotDefs.ById[owned.DefId]
		if def then
			local mutation = Config.Mutations[1]
			for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do
				if m.Name == owned.Mutation then
					mutation = m
					break
				end
			end
			local slot = State.freeSlot(base)
			if slot then
				local fused = owned.Fused or false
				local model = BrainrotFactory.build(def, mutation, BrainrotFactory.bodyCenter(base.Slots[slot], def), fused)
				model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
				BrainrotFactory.setLabel(model, def, mutation, nil, fused)
				local click = model:FindFirstChild("Body") and model.Body:FindFirstChild("BuyClick")
				if click then
					click:Destroy()
				end
				table.insert(State.Active, {
					Id = State.NextBrainrotId,
					Model = model,
					Def = def,
					Mutation = mutation,
					State = "owned",
					Owner = player,
					BaseIndex = base.Index,
					SlotIndex = slot,
					Fused = fused,
					Price = def.Price,
					X = 0,
				})
				State.NextBrainrotId += 1
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Pemain baru (belum pernah rebirth, belum pernah dapat income) diberi
-- 2 brainrot Common gratis supaya base tidak kosong di screenshot
-- pertama dan loop income langsung terasa. Setelah rebirth tidak dapat
-- starter lagi, karena rebirth memang mengosongkan base.
local function grantStarterBrainrots(player, data)
	if data.Rebirths > 0 or data.TotalEarned > 0 or #data.Owned > 0 then
		return
	end
	for _, starterId in ipairs(Config.StarterBrainrots) do
		table.insert(data.Owned, { DefId = starterId, Mutation = "Normal", Fused = false })
	end
end

-- Judul rebirth di atas kepala: "REBIRTH xN" — status sosial di server.
local function updateRebirthTitle(player, data)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then
		return
	end
	local old = head:FindFirstChild("RebirthTitle")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	if data.Rebirths <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "RebirthTitle"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 120)
	label.Text = "REBIRTH x" .. data.Rebirths
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = head
end

-- v3.1: PAKSA karakter menghadap UTARA (-Z, ke conveyor/base).
-- SpawnLocation Orientation Y=0 saja TIDAK cukup: di playtest v2.2,
-- v2.3 DAN v3.0 karakter tetap spawn menghadap SELATAN (+Z, ke tepi
-- map kosong) dan kamera ikut menghadap selatan, jadi conveyor, sign,
-- dan base (semuanya di utara) tidak terlihat. Karena itu arah hadap
-- dipaksa di sini lewat HumanoidRootPart.CFrame — bukan lewat
-- SpawnLocation. Dipanggil sekali saat spawn DAN sekali lagi setelah
-- 0.5 detik, karena Roblox kadang mengorientasi ulang karakter sesaat
-- setelah spawn. SpawnLocation tetap Y=0 (jangan dibalik ke 180).
local function faceNorth(character)
	local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	local pos = hrp.Position
	hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, pos + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
	print("[FusionBay] SPAWN menghadap utara")
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local data = DataSystem.load(player)
	LeaderboardSystem.setupPlayer(player)
	StealSystem.noteJoin(player)
	local base = State.assignBase(player)
	if base then
		base.NameLabel.Text = "Base " .. player.Name
		base.NameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		print("[FusionBay] BASE v2: " .. player.Name .. " -> Base " .. base.Index .. " di (" .. base.Center.X .. ", " .. base.Center.Z .. ")")
	end
	grantStarterBrainrots(player, data)
	spawnOwnedBrainrots(player, data)
	print("[FusionBay] PLAYER v2: " .. player.Name .. " starter=" .. #data.Owned .. " brainrot, base=" .. (base and base.Index or 0))
	StealSystem.giveSlapTool(player)
	-- Terapkan Speed Boots saat karakter spawn + judul rebirth.
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		faceNorth(character)
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			faceNorth(character)
		end)
		task.wait(0.5)
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and data.Items.boots then
			hum.WalkSpeed = Config.BootsWalkSpeed
		end
		updateRebirthTitle(player, data)
		-- Beri lagi Slap tool kalau hilang saat respawn.
		StealSystem.giveSlapTool(player)
	end)
	-- Kalau karakter sudah ada saat onPlayerAdded jalan (rejoin cepat),
	-- CharacterAdded tidak akan fire lagi — paksa hadap utara langsung.
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(faceNorth, player.Character)
	end
	task.wait(1)
	EconomySystem.pushUI(player)
	Remotes.notify(player, "Selamat datang di Fusion Bay! Klik brainrot di conveyor untuk membeli. Gabungkan 2 brainrot sama di Fusion Altar!")
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	-- Kembalikan brainrot curian yang sedang dibawa.
	if State.Carrying[player] then
		StealSystem.dropCarried(player, true)
	end
	-- Hapus model brainrot milik pemain dari dunia.
	for i = #State.Active, 1, -1 do
		local rec = State.Active[i]
		if rec.State == "owned" and rec.Owner == player then
			if rec.Model then
				rec.Model:Destroy()
			end
			table.remove(State.Active, i)
		end
	end
	local base = State.baseForPlayer(player)
	if base then
		base.Owner = nil
		base.NameLabel.Text = "Base " .. base.Index .. " (kosong)"
	end
	DataSystem.save(player)
	DataSystem.clear(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

Spawner.start()
EconomySystem.start()
StealSystem.start()
WaveSystem.start()
LeaderboardSystem.start()

-- Penanda versi di Output: kalau baris ini tidak muncul, user membuka
-- file LAMA, bukan build v3.0 ini.
local walking = 0
for _, rec in ipairs(State.Active) do
	if rec.State == "walking" then
		walking += 1
	end
end
print("[FusionBay] BUILD v3.3 recorded rebuild: tanpa baseplate, tanah hijau atas y=1, conveyor terang, brainrot tes di depan spawn, spawn dipaksa menghadap utara (server+camera), conveyor z=30, model 2.0x, grounding 1.6x (kaki menapak), sign kecil di spawn, brainrot di conveyor=" .. walking)
print("Fusion Bay server started.")
```

```lua
-- Fusion Bay v3.0 — bangun model 3D brainrot dari Part (tanpa aset eksternal).

-- - Bentuk badan beda per karakter (box / ball / cylinder dari def.Shape).

-- 0.6*s, jadi dasar kaki = body - 1.6*s. Rumus lama (ground + 1.3*s)

-- ~ di permukaan tanah, bukan terkubur.

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)

local BrainrotFactory = {}

local function part(parent, name, size, pos, color, shape, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Position = pos
	p.Color = color
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	if shape == "ball" then
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	elseif shape == "cylinder" then
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	else
		p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	end
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

-- Aksesori dibuat relatif terhadap origin (0,0,0), lalu build()
-- menggeser semuanya ke `position`. Ukuran dikali `s` (skala rarity).
local function addAccessory(model, kind, s)

		return part(model, name, size * s, pos * s, color)
	end
	if kind == "banana" then

-- Skala total model: RarityScale * 2.0.
function BrainrotFactory.scaleFor(def)
	return (Config.RarityScale[def.Rarity] or 1) * 2.0
end

-- Ubah titik TANAH (slot base / altar / conveyor) menjadi titik badan.
-- Verifikasi: dasar kaki = bodyCenter - 1.6*s = ground (tepat menapak).
function BrainrotFactory.bodyCenter(groundPos, def)
	local s = BrainrotFactory.scaleFor(def)
	return groundPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 * s, 0)
end

-- Pindah model brainrot ke titik badan baru TANPA PivotTo (v3.2).
-- PivotTo memakai pusat bounding-box model sebagai pivot, bukan Body:
-- bbox membentang dari atas kepala ~+2.7*s sampai dasar cincin ~-1.6*s,
-- jadi pusatnya ~+0.55*s di atas badan — setiap PivotTo menggeser
-- seluruh model KE BAWAH ~0.55*s dan mengubur kaki + cincin, padahal
-- bodyCenter() sudah benar. TranslateBy menggeser semua part dengan
-- vektor yang sama dan tidak punya ambiguitas pivot, jadi ini satu-satunya
-- cara memindah model brainrot. JANGAN pakai PivotTo / MoveTo /
-- SetPrimaryPartCFrame untuk model brainrot di mana pun.
function BrainrotFactory.moveTo(model, bodyCenterPos)
	local pp = model and model.PrimaryPart
	if pp then
		model:TranslateBy(bodyCenterPos - pp.Position)
	end
end

function BrainrotFactory.build(def, mutation, position, fused)
	local s = BrainrotFactory.scaleFor(def)
	local rarityColor = Config.Rarities[def.Rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = def.Name

	-- Badan: sumbu silinder Roblox berjalan di X, jadi badan silinder
	-- dibuat memanjang di X lalu diputar 90 derajat di Z agar tegak.
	local bodySize = Vector3.new(2.4 * s, 2.2 * s, 1.6 * s)
	if def.Shape == "cylinder" then
		bodySize = Vector3.new(2.2 * s, 2.4 * s, 2.4 * s)
	end
	local body = part(model, "Body", bodySize, position, def.Body, def.Shape)
	if def.Shape == "cylinder" then
		body.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
	end
	-- Mutation Diamond: badan Neon transparan. Golden: Neon lembut.
	if mutation.Name == "Diamond" then
		body.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		body.Transparency = 0.15
	elseif mutation.Name == "Golden" then
		body.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		body.Transparency = 0.05
	end

	local headSize = Vector3.new(1.8 * s, 1.6 * s, 1.6 * s)
	if def.Shape == "cylinder" then
		headSize = Vector3.new(1.6 * s, 1.8 * s, 1.8 * s)
	end
	local head = part(model, "Head", headSize, position + Vector3.new(0, 1.9 * s, 0), def.Head, def.Shape)
	if def.Shape == "cylinder" then
		head.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
	end
	-- Mata menghadap +Z (arah kamera dari spawn).
	part(model, "EyeL", Vector3.new(0.35 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.2), position + Vector3.new(-0.45 * s, 2.1 * s, 0.85 * s), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20))
	part(model, "EyeR", Vector3.new(0.35 * s, 0.5 * s, 0.2), position + Vector3.new(0.45 * s, 2.1 * s, 0.85 * s), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20))
	-- Kaki.
	part(model, "FootL", Vector3.new(0.8 * s, 0.6 * s, 1), position + Vector3.new(-0.6 * s, -1.3 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))
	part(model, "FootR", Vector3.new(0.8 * s, 0.6 * s, 1), position + Vector3.new(0.6 * s, -1.3 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60))

	addAccessory(model, def.Accessory, s)
	-- Geser aksesori (yang dibuat relatif terhadap origin) ke position.
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 9) == "Accessory" then
			child.Position = child.Position + position
		end
	end

	-- Cincin rarity di bawah model (Neon, warna rarity). Pusat di
	-- body - 1.5*s: dasar cincin = ground + 0.1*s - 0.125, jadi
	-- ~ di permukaan tanah (tidak terkubur seperti di -1.7*s).
	local ring = part(model, "RarityRing", Vector3.new(0.25, 3.4 * s, 3.4 * s),
		position + Vector3.new(0, -1.5 * s, 0), rarityColor, "cylinder", Enum.Material.Neon)
	ring.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)

	-- Efek mutation: Golden = trim emas di kepala; Rainbow = 3 orb warna.
	if mutation.Name == "Golden" then
		part(model, "GoldTrim", Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 0.3, 1.8 * s),
			position + Vector3.new(0, 2.9 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), "box", Enum.Material.Neon)
	elseif mutation.Name == "Rainbow" then
		local orbColors = { Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120), Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 255) }
		for i, c in ipairs(orbColors) do
			local angle = (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / 3)
			part(model, "RainbowOrb" .. i, Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),
				position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 1.8 * s, 3.2 * s, math.sin(angle) * 1.8 * s),
				c, "ball", Enum.Material.Neon)
		end
	end

	-- FUSED: mahkota emas besar di atas kepala (hasil Fusion Altar).
	if fused then
		part(model, "FusedCrown", Vector3.new(2.2 * s, 1.0 * s, 2.2 * s),
			position + Vector3.new(0, 3.6 * s, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), "box", Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- Mythic: partikel emas halus di badan (rate kecil, satu emitter saja).
	if def.Rarity == "Mythic" then
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = "MythicSparkle"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0))
		emitter.Rate = 4
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2)
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
		emitter.Parent = body
	end
	_ = head

	-- Label nama/rarity/income/harga. Offset 2.8*s supaya label duduk di
	-- atas kepala model 2.0x (offset 4.5 akan menembus kepala).
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "Label"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8 * s, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.MaxDistance = 50
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = "Text"
	text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6
	text.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
	text.TextColor3 = mutation.Color
	text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	text.TextScaled = true
	text.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	text.Text = def.Name
	text.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = body

	local click = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
	click.Name = "BuyClick"
	click.MaxActivationDistance = 32
	click.Parent = body

	model.PrimaryPart = body
	-- v3.2: JANGAN PivotTo di sini. Semua part sudah diposisikan absolut
	-- di atas; PivotTo memakai pusat bounding-box (~+0.55*s di atas
	-- badan) sebagai pivot dan akan menggeser model ke bawah ~0.55*s,
	-- mengubur kaki + cincin. Lihat BrainrotFactory.moveTo().
	return model
end

-- Isi ulang teks label (setelah dibeli / di-fusion / dicuri):
-- "Nama\nMutation Rarity | $X/s" + "BELI: $Y" kalau masih di conveyor.
function BrainrotFactory.setLabel(model, def, mutation, priceOrNil, fused)
	local body = model:FindFirstChild("Body")
	if not body then
		return
	end
	local gui = body:FindFirstChild("Label")
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	local text = gui:FindFirstChild("Text")
	if not text then
		return
	end
	local income = def.Income * mutation.Mult
	local name = def.Name
	if fused then
		name = "FUSED " .. name
	end
	local line = string.format(
		"%s\n%s %s | %s/s",
		name,
		mutation.Name,
		def.Rarity,
		Config.formatMoney(income)
	)
	if priceOrNil then
		line ..= string.format("\nBELI: %s", Config.formatMoney(priceOrNil))
	end
	text.Text = line
	text.TextColor3 = mutation.Color
end

return BrainrotFactory
```

```lua
-- Fusion Bay v3.0 — data pemain (DataStore + pcall, autosave, BindToClose).
--
-- PELAJARAN PLAYTEST v2: GetDataStore THROW di place yang belum publish
-- ("You must publish this place to the web to access DataStore").
-- Kalau dilempar di top-level, script mati sebelum MapBuilder jalan dan
-- map jadi baseplate kosong. Jadi BOTH GetDataStore dan
-- GetOrderedDataStore dibungkus pcall; kalau gagal, store = nil dan game
-- tetap jalan penuh dengan data sesi saja (peringatan kuning, bukan error).

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Config)

local DataSystem = {}

local _storeOk, _store = pcall(function()
	return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DataStoreName)
end)
local store = _storeOk and _store or nil
if not store then
	warn("[FusionBay] DataStore tidak tersedia (place belum publish / API Services mati) — data tidak tersimpan antar sesi, game tetap jalan.")
end

local sessionData = {}

function DataSystem.default()
	return {
		Coins = Config.StartCoins,
		TotalEarned = 0,
		Rebirths = 0,
		Owned = {}, -- {DefId, Mutation, Fused}
		Items = { boots = false, lucky = false },
		Steals = 0,
	}
end

function DataSystem.load(player)
	local data = DataSystem.default()
	if not store then
		sessionData[player] = data
		return data
	end
	local success, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)
	if success and type(saved) == "table" then
		for key, value in pairs(saved) do
			if data[key] ~= nil then
				data[key] = value
			end
		end
		if type(data.Owned) ~= "table" then
			data.Owned = {}
		end
		if type(data.Items) ~= "table" then
			data.Items = { boots = false, lucky = false }
		end
	end
	sessionData[player] = data
	return data
end

function DataSystem.get(player)
	return sessionData[player]
end

function DataSystem.save(player)
	local data = sessionData[player]
	if not data or not store then
		return
	end
	local clean = {
		Coins = data.Coins,
		TotalEarned = data.TotalEarned,
		Rebirths = data.Rebirths,
		Owned = data.Owned,
		Items = data.Items,
		Steals = data.Steals,
	}
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), clean)
	end)
end

function DataSystem.clear(player)
	sessionData[player] = nil
end

function DataSystem.addOwned(player, defId, mutationName, fused)
	local data = sessionData[player]
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	table.insert(data.Owned, { DefId = defId, Mutation = mutationName, Fused = fused or false })
	return true
end

function DataSystem.removeOwned(player, defId, mutationName, fused)
	local data = sessionData[player]
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	for i, owned in ipairs(data.Owned) do
		if owned.DefId == defId and owned.Mutation == mutationName
			and (fused == nil or owned.Fused == fused) then
			table.remove(data.Owned, i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Autosave berkala + simpan saat server mati. Keduanya nil-guarded
-- lewat DataSystem.save (no-op kalau store nil).
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.AutosaveSeconds)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			DataSystem.save(player)
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		DataSystem.save(player)
	end
end)

return DataSystem
```

```lua
-- FUSION (twist juara): 2 brainrot rarity sama milik sendiri -> 1
-- brainrot rarity satu tingkat di atas, mutation minimal Golden.
-- Mythic + Mythic -> Mythic dengan mutation Rainbow yang dijamin.
function EconomySystem.fuseBrainrots(player, id1, id2)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastFuse[player] and now - lastFuse[player] < Config.FusionCooldownSeconds then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Fusion masih cooldown!")
		return
	end
	if id1 == id2 then
		return
	end
	local data = DataSystem.get(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local rec1, rec2 = nil, nil
	for _, rec in ipairs(State.Active) do
		if rec.State == "owned" and rec.Owner == player then
			if rec.Id == id1 then
				rec1 = rec
			elseif rec.Id == id2 then
				rec2 = rec
			end
		end
	end
	if not rec1 or not rec2 then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Pilih 2 brainrot dari basemu!")
		return
	end
	if rec1.Def.Rarity ~= rec2.Def.Rarity then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Fusion butuh 2 brainrot dengan rarity yang SAMA!")
		return
	end
	lastFuse[player] = now
	local base = State.baseForPlayer(player)
	if not base then
		return
	end
	-- Hasil: rarity naik satu tingkat, def acak di tier itu.
	local nextRarity = Config.nextRarity(rec1.Def.Rarity)
	local candidates = BrainrotDefs.ofRarity(nextRarity)
	local resultDef = candidates[math.random(#candidates)]
	-- Mutation: minimal Golden; Mythic + Mythic -> Rainbow dijamin.
	local mutation
	if rec1.Def.Rarity == "Mythic" then
		mutation = Config.Mutations[4] -- Rainbow
	else
		mutation = Config.rollFusionMutation()
	end
	-- Hapus 2 brainrot asal (model + data).
	for _, rec in ipairs({ rec1, rec2 }) do
		DataSystem.removeOwned(player, rec.Def.Id, rec.Mutation.Name, rec.Fused or false)
		if rec.Model then
			rec.Model:Destroy()
		end
		for i, active in ipairs(State.Active) do
			if active == rec then
				table.remove(State.Active, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	-- Hasil fusion muncul di Fusion Altar, lalu pindah ke slot kosong.
	local slot = State.freeSlot(base)
	if not slot then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Base penuh! Fusion gagal.")
		return
	end
	DataSystem.addOwned(player, resultDef.Id, mutation.Name, true)
	local model = BrainrotFactory.build(resultDef, mutation, BrainrotFactory.bodyCenter(base.AltarPos, resultDef), true)
	model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	BrainrotFactory.setLabel(model, resultDef, mutation, nil, true)
	local click = model:FindFirstChild("Body") and model.Body:FindFirstChild("BuyClick")
	if click then
		click:Destroy()
	end
	table.insert(State.Active, {
		Id = State.NextBrainrotId,
		Model = model,
		Def = resultDef,
		Mutation = mutation,
		State = "owned",
		Owner = player,
		BaseIndex = base.Index,
		SlotIndex = slot,
		Fused = true,
		Price = resultDef.Price,
		X = 0,
	})
	State.NextBrainrotId += 1
	task.delay(0.8, function()
		if model.Parent then
			-- v3.2: TranslateBy via moveTo, bukan PivotTo.
			BrainrotFactory.moveTo(model, BrainrotFactory.bodyCenter(base.Slots[slot], resultDef))
		end
	end)
	Remotes.notify(player, "FUSION! " .. resultDef.Name .. " (" .. mutation.Name .. " " .. nextRarity .. ")!")
	Remotes.notifyAll(player.Name .. " melakukan FUSION: " .. resultDef.Name .. "!")
	EconomySystem.pushUI(player)
end

-- Rebirth: bayar coin + syarat karakter Epic/Legendary, base direset,
-- coin kembali ke awal, income berlipat (x2/x3/x4). Total Earned dan
-- jumlah steal TIDAK direset.
function EconomySystem.rebirth(player)
	local data = DataSystem.get(player)
	if not data then
		return
	end
	local level = Config.nextRebirth(data.Rebirths)
	if not level then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Kamu sudah mencapai rebirth maksimal!")
		return
	end
	if data.Coins < level.Cost then
		Remotes.notify(player, "Rebirth butuh " .. Config.formatMoney(level.Cost) .. " coin!")
		return
	end
	local epicCount, legendaryCount = 0, 0
	for _, rec in ipairs(State.Active) do
		if rec.State == "owned" and rec.Owner == player then
			if rec.Def.Rarity == "Epic" then
				epicCount += 1
			elseif rec.Def.Rarity == "Legendary" then
				legendaryCount += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if epicCount < level.NeedEpic or legendaryCount < level.NeedLegendary then
		local need = {}
		if level.NeedEpic > 0 then
			table.insert(need, level.NeedEpic .. " Epic (punya " .. epicCount .. ")")
		end
		if level.NeedLegendary > 0 then
			table.insert(need, level.NeedLegendary .. " Legendary (punya " .. legendaryCount .. ")")
		end
		Remotes.notify(player, "Rebirth butuh: " .. table.concat(need, ", "))
		return
	end
	-- Hapus model brainrot milik pemain dari base.
	for i = #State.Active, 1, -1 do
		local rec = State.Active[i]
		if rec.State == "owned" and rec.Owner == player then
			if rec.Model then
				rec.Model:Destroy()
			end
			table.remove(State.Active, i)
		end
	end
	data.Coins = Config.StartCoins
	data.Owned = {}
	data.Rebirths += 1
	-- Judul rebirth langsung muncul di atas kepala tanpa menunggu respawn.
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head then
		local old = head:FindFirstChild("RebirthTitle")
		if old then
			old:Destroy()
		end
		local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "RebirthTitle"
		gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
		gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
		label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 120)
		label.Text = "REBIRTH x" .. data.Rebirths
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0)
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		label.Parent = gui
		gui.Parent = head
	end
	Remotes.notify(player, "REBIRTH! Income sekarang x" .. level.Mult .. ". Rebirth ke-" .. data.Rebirths)
	Remotes.notifyAll(player.Name .. " REBIRTH ke-" .. data.Rebirths .. "!")
	EconomySystem.pushUI(player)
end

-- Income tick tiap detik + hubungkan Remote + refresh cincin kunci base.
function EconomySystem.start()
	Remotes.BuyItemEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemId)
		if typeof(itemId) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		EconomySystem.buyItem(player, itemId)
	end)
	Remotes.RebirthEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
		EconomySystem.rebirth(player)
	end)
	Remotes.FuseEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, id1, id2)
		if typeof(id1) ~= "number" or typeof(id2) ~= "number" then
			return
		end
		EconomySystem.fuseBrainrots(player, id1, id2)
	end)
	Remotes.GetPlayerData.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
		local data = DataSystem.get(player)
		if not data then
			return nil
		end
		return {
			Coins = data.Coins,
			TotalEarned = data.TotalEarned,
			Rebirths = data.Rebirths,
			OwnedCount = #data.Owned,
			Steals = data.Steals,
		}
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.IncomeTickSeconds)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local data = DataSystem.get(player)
				if data then
					local income = State.incomePerSecond(player, data, Config)
					if income > 0 then
						data.Coins += income
						data.TotalEarned += income
					end
					EconomySystem.pushUI(player)
				end
			end
			-- Cincin kunci: terlihat saat base terkunci, hilang saat habis.
			for _, base in ipairs(State.Bases) do
				if base.LockRing then
					base.LockRing.Transparency = State.isLocked(base) and 0.3 or 1
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end
```
